question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the bracketed idiom in the given sentence.**

The last observation of yours has (**hit the nail on the head**).

options.text: To have no idea about anything
A personal interest in the matter

solution:
The correct answer is **"Find exactly the right answer."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Hit the nail on the head"** is an idiom that means to find exactly the right answer or solution. (ऐसी बात कहना जो बिलकुल सही हो)

 
 
• **Example: ***I think David **hit the nail on the head**__ when he said that kids won't want to buy this product.*
 
 
 
• The observation mentioned in the sentence is accurate and correct.
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 4**.
